The script's purpose is to modify the database schema by adding a new column named `relative_path` to the `derived_contents` table. This script is intended to be part of a series of migrations that manage the evolution of the database schema over time. It does not define public APIs or external interfaces, as its primary function is to alter the database structure in a controlled manner.
